2. Evidence
- evidence/TR-L-T-20261009/baseline.txt: wsl.exe -e bash -lc 'cd <repo>; node plugins/pipeline-core/scripts/capture-evidence.mjs --out evidence/TR-L-T-20261009/baseline.txt --label baseline -- node --test --test-reporter=spec <the two live files>', exit 0.
- evidence/TR-L-T-20261009/red.txt: same wrapper, label TR-L-T-red, files scratch/dispatch-wip/TR-L-T/guard-testpath.test.mjs and guard-testpath-override.test.mjs, wrapped exit 1 (OT21, OT23).
- Post-image vs live diff (WSL diff): only additions, plus two intended edits in file 1 (cleanup list gained T84_DIR; last names entry gained a comma). Post-image vs run copy: only import paths and the GUARD/HOOKS lines.
- sha256: guard-testpath.test.mjs 2753b664ae50a42696d7815b61278e9176b0d17b5a632f3a964735eec8a20951; guard-testpath-override.test.mjs 234cf45ccadf61f2ae36b7dfe0dc5d0ef1034111c4a6de264b04725802b07d3c.

3. Changed files (committed)
- specs/sprint-alfred-epic/signed-package/tranche-2/hooks/guard-testpath.test.mjs: TP-2 post-image, new cases TP19-TP21.
- specs/sprint-alfred-epic/signed-package/tranche-2/hooks/guard-testpath-override.test.mjs: TP-7 post-image, new cases OT20-OT23.
- specs/sprint-alfred-epic/signed-package/tranche-2/TR-L-MANIFEST.md: targets, sha256, WSL command, per-pin state, assumptions.
Uncommitted by design: evidence/TR-L-T-20261009/{baseline,red}.txt, this record, scratch copies and message under scratch/.

4. Deliberately not changed
- Nothing under plugins/, harness/, the tranche README.md, other post-images, the real staged lib/guard/sanctioned-args-onboarding.mjs (fixtures in temp repos only), the calibration file.
- A plain git restore -- <file> while the index differs from HEAD, git checkout -- <file>, --staged/--worktree alone, --source=<sha of HEAD>: left unpinned (named in the headers).

5. Deviations from spec
- The T84 text does not name the admitted spellings. I pinned the two that provably yield HEAD's bytes (plain restore with a clean index; explicit --source=HEAD --staged --worktree) and named the rest as unpinned assumptions rather than choosing verdicts.
- The write-lane half ('one decision per file across hunks') is GREEN, not RED: the lane decides from the path alone and I could not reproduce the log's (L88) admitted-hunk-1 mechanism. TP19-TP21 and OT20 are therefore invariants the TR-L change must keep, not a reproduction. Stated in both headers and the manifest.
- The restore pins drive the library classifier protectedTestPathShellHit({command, rules, root}); neither post-image spawns guard-lifecycle-ready.mjs. If TR-L moves the decision to another function, OT21-OT23 need re-pointing.
- Bootstrap line: the briefing names no calibration file, so the line says so instead of naming one. Route pre-check: requested claude-sonnet-5-5/xhigh, observed claude-sonnet-5-5, no contradiction.
- Post-images were produced by Write twice (run copy, then final) and verified by diff, not by cp+Edit.

6. Open items
- Independent Critic review pending (Elephant dispatches it). Placement of both files is the signed ceremony (TP-2, TP-7).
- Finding for the Elephant: po-list T84 gives 'git restore -- plugins/pipeline-core/lib/guard/sanctioned-args-onboarding.mjs'. That file is staged (index modified, tree equal to index), and a plain git restore -- <file> restores the tree from the INDEX, so it would be a no-op there. The command that really returns a staged file to committed bytes is git restore --source=HEAD --staged --worktree -- <file> (pinned in OT23).
- OT21 and OT23 stay RED until the TR-L implementation lands. No stop condition triggered. Budget: 47 of 55 counted calls.
